toolsPreview.name: applehealth__steps_read

toolsPreview.name: bluesky__trending_get
toolsPreview.description: [bluesky · risk:low] Fetch the current trending topics on Bluesky. Returns topic names, display labels, and links to the topic feed. No account or API key required.

toolsPreview.name: chase__balance_check
toolsPreview.description: [chase · risk:low] Read the current balance of a Chase account (read-only)

toolsPreview.name: datadog__logs_view
toolsPreview.description: [datadog · risk:low] Search and read logs from Datadog over a time range

toolsPreview.name: delta__boardingpass_show
toolsPreview.description: [delta · risk:low] Pull up the boarding pass for a Delta flight

toolsPreview.name: duvera__dev_npm_package
toolsPreview.description: [duvera · risk:low] Look up the latest version, description, license, and dependencies of an npm package. Works for scoped packages too (e.g. "@types/node"). No account required.

toolsPreview.name: duvera__dev_pypi_package
toolsPreview.description: [duvera · risk:low] Look up the current version, summary, license, and homepage of a Python package on PyPI. No account required.

toolsPreview.name: duvera__dev_stackoverflow_search
toolsPreview.description: [duvera · risk:low] Search Stack Overflow questions by keyword. Returns top 5 by relevance with title, link, score, and answer status. No account required.

toolsPreview.name: duvera__finance_crypto_price
toolsPreview.description: [duvera · risk:low] Current spot price for one or more cryptocurrencies (CoinGecko ids like "bitcoin,ethereum,solana") in a fiat currency (default USD). Read-only market data. No account required.

toolsPreview.name: duvera__finance_exchange_rates
toolsPreview.description: [duvera · risk:low] Live USD exchange rates against major currencies. Read-only, no account required.

toolsPreview.name: duvera__food_recipe_search
toolsPreview.description: [duvera · risk:low] Search recipes by dish name (e.g. "arrabiata", "pad thai"). Returns ingredients, instructions, category, and cuisine. No account required.

toolsPreview.name: duvera__food_restaurant_search
toolsPreview.description: [duvera · risk:low] Search for restaurants and food places by name or location using OpenStreetMap. Read-only, no account required.

toolsPreview.name: duvera__geo_geocode
toolsPreview.description: [duvera · risk:low] Convert a city or place name (e.g. "Berlin", "San Francisco") to latitude/longitude, country, timezone, and population. Use this before weather.current or weather.air-quality when you only have a place name. No account required.

toolsPreview.name: duvera__github_latest_release
toolsPreview.description: [duvera · risk:low] Get the latest published release (tag, name, notes, date) of a public GitHub repository. Returns 404 for repos that publish no releases. No auth required.

toolsPreview.name: duvera__github_read_file
toolsPreview.description: [duvera · risk:low] Read a file from a public GitHub repository. Read-only.

toolsPreview.name: duvera__github_search_repos
toolsPreview.description: [duvera · risk:low] Search public GitHub repositories by keyword. Returns top 5 results by stars. No auth required.

toolsPreview.name: duvera__news_search
toolsPreview.description: [duvera · risk:low] Search Hacker News stories by keyword, ranked by relevance. Returns title, URL, points, author, and comment count. No account required.

toolsPreview.name: duvera__news_top_stories
toolsPreview.description: [duvera · risk:low] Top stories from Hacker News. Read-only, no account required.

toolsPreview.name: duvera__reference_dictionary
toolsPreview.description: [duvera · risk:low] Definitions, phonetics, part of speech, and examples for an English word. No account required.

toolsPreview.name: duvera__reference_public_holidays
toolsPreview.description: [duvera · risk:low] Public holidays for a given year and ISO country code (e.g. 2026 + "US"). Includes national and regional holidays with dates and names. No account required.

toolsPreview.name: duvera__time_now
toolsPreview.description: [duvera · risk:low] Current date and time in an IANA timezone (e.g. "America/New_York", "Asia/Tokyo"). Includes day of week and DST status. No account required.

toolsPreview.name: duvera__travel_flight_search
toolsPreview.description: [duvera · risk:low] List aircraft currently airborne within a radius of a point (adsb.lol ADS-B data). Use geo.geocode to get a city's coordinates first. Returns callsign, altitude, speed, and position. No account required.

toolsPreview.name: duvera__weather_air_quality
toolsPreview.description: [duvera · risk:low] Current air quality (US AQI, PM2.5, PM10, ozone) for a latitude/longitude. Use geo.geocode first if you only have a place name. No account required.

toolsPreview.name: duvera__weather_current
toolsPreview.description: [duvera · risk:low] Current temperature, conditions, wind, and humidity for a latitude/longitude (Open-Meteo). Use geo.geocode first if you only have a city or place name. No account required.

toolsPreview.name: duvera__wiki_search
toolsPreview.description: [duvera · risk:low] Search Wikipedia articles by keyword. Returns matching page titles, keys, and excerpts. Pass a result's key to wiki.summary for the article summary. No account required.

toolsPreview.name: duvera__wiki_summary
toolsPreview.description: [duvera · risk:low] Get the lead summary of a Wikipedia article by title (e.g. "Zero_trust_architecture"). Use wiki.search first to find the exact page key. No account required.

toolsPreview.name: gmail__mail_read
toolsPreview.description: [gmail · risk:low] Read recent emails from the Gmail inbox

toolsPreview.name: google_workspace__mail_search
toolsPreview.description: [google-workspace · risk:low] Search Mail via Gmail, governed by Duvera.

toolsPreview.name: googlecalendar__availability_find
toolsPreview.description: [googlecalendar · risk:low] Find open time slots within a date range in Google Calendar

toolsPreview.name: grubhub__order_track
toolsPreview.description: [grubhub · risk:low] Check the live status and ETA of a Grubhub order

toolsPreview.name: hackernews__stories_top
toolsPreview.description: [hackernews · risk:low] Fetch the current list of top-story ids on Hacker News. Returns an array of item ids (resolve details via the item endpoint). No account or API key required; the hacker-news.firebaseio.com endpoint is open and unmetered.

toolsPreview.name: opensky__flights_live
toolsPreview.description: [opensky · risk:low] List aircraft currently airborne within a latitude/longitude box, from OpenSky's live ADS-B feed.
